evals.prompt: /ask-questions 'Add CSV export to the orders dashboard. Agents need to download filtered order lists for month-end reconciliation. Must respect the existing column visibility settings.' (current branch: feat/ENG-123-csv-export; .agents/ is not git-ignored)
evals.expected_output: Two documents in .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-123-csv-export/ — 01-request-csv-export.html and 02-research-questions-<area>.html (named for the area under study, e.g. export-downloads) — rendered via Skill('output-html'), after one AskUserQuestion call covering the flow (with chart and recommendation) and the compatibility posture, ending with a /research-codebase handoff that names the task directory and flow
expectations: Resolves the task directory from the branch name with '/' replaced by '-' (.agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-123-csv-export/) and states the path

Writes two documents: NN-request-<desc> (PHASE=request, STATUS=complete) first, then NN-research-questions-<desc> (PHASE=questions, STATUS=ready-for-research) with the next number, both via Skill('output-html') with the full stem passed
The questions document has 2-7 current-state questions, each beginning with a category tag and carrying a concrete starting pointer; none reveals the desired CSV export change

The questions document's TOPIC, TITLE, and filename <desc> name the area under study (e.g. order export and downloads), not the CSV export feature; the request document keeps the feature name (01-request-csv-export)

The questions document has no human-only Context section; the desired change appears only in the request document (Original request, Desired result, Constraints and acceptance criteria, Source pointers, Flow and compatibility)
Does not read source files itself; at most one small codebase-locator pass is dispatched, given the topic area (exports/downloads, column visibility) rather than the desired change

Shows the box-drawing flow chart (no Mermaid), briefly recommends a flow, includes the note that implementation can start from any step, and asks the flow and compatibility posture in the same AskUserQuestion call
Because the task directory is new and .agents/ is not ignored, offers once to add .agents/ to .git/info/exclude and acts only on agreement

Request document META_EXTRA carries crispy:ticket_source, crispy:breaking_changes_allowed, crispy:compatibility_context, crispy:task_dir, crispy:flow, crispy:repos; the questions document carries the posture fields plus crispy:task_dir, crispy:flow, crispy:repos

Hands off with saved paths, an offer to open the documents for review (no gh-commit offer), and the command '/research-codebase .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-123-csv-export flow: <chosen-flow>' runnable here, after compaction, or in a new session; does not start research

evals.prompt: /ask-questions --format=md flow: tdd 'Our background jobs sometimes process the same message twice. Investigate what we'd need to know before adding idempotency.' (current branch: main)
evals.expected_output: Markdown request and research-questions documents in a slug-named task directory such as .agents/artifacts/job-idempotency/, with the flow taken from the command line rather than asked
expectations: On main, uses a short kebab-case slug from the request for the task directory under .agents/artifacts/ and states the path
Because --format=md was passed, delegates both documents to Skill('output-markdown'), writing NN-request-<desc>.md and NN-research-questions-<desc>.md
Because flow: tdd was given, does not ask the flow question and records crispy:flow = tdd on both documents
Questions target current state — how jobs are dispatched and consumed, where message handling lives, existing dedup/retry behavior, test patterns for job handlers — and stay within 2-7
No question asks for a design opinion ('what's the best way', 'how should') or names files to change
Does not interrogate the user for more feature context; the only question asked, if any, is the compatibility posture when the request does not settle it
crispy:repos is gathered as <identifier>@<sha> entries from gh repo view / git rev-parse HEAD
Uses only the shared slot vocabulary (PHASE, STATUS, TOPIC, TITLE, TICKET, PROMPT_TEXT, META_EXTRA, SUMMARY_EXTRA) without inventing new slots
Handoff names '/research-codebase .agents/artifacts/<task> flow: tdd'

evals.prompt: ENG-412: Tenants can't rotate their API keys without support intervention. Self-serve rotation from the settings page, old key valid for 24h. Where do we start?
evals.expected_output: ask-questions does not trigger — it is a manual-only CRISPY phase (disable-model-invocation: true), so a pasted ticket without /ask-questions is handled as an ordinary conversation
expectations: Does NOT invoke ask-questions: the user did not run /ask-questions, and the skill is manual-only
No documents are written to .agents/artifacts/
May answer directly or suggest running /ask-questions with the ticket to start the CRISPY workflow

evals.prompt: /ask-questions 'PLAT-88: Add pagination to the public /v1/reports endpoint. This endpoint is published in our partner API docs and three external integrators poll it today, so existing callers must keep working through the migration window.'
evals.expected_output: Request and research-questions documents whose compatibility posture is inferred as breaking_changes_allowed: false from the ticket, so AskUserQuestion asks only the flow, with a Breaking changes summary row reading 'not allowed'
expectations: Infers crispy:breaking_changes_allowed: false from the published-API and external-integrator language and does not ask about the posture; the AskUserQuestion call asks only the flow
Records crispy:compatibility_context on both documents with a one-line explanation citing the published endpoint and external integrators
The SUMMARY_EXTRA Breaking changes row reads 'not allowed' on both documents

Questions cover current state relevant to a compatibility-constrained change: how the endpoint is routed and versioned, how responses are serialized, existing pagination conventions elsewhere, how API contract or schema tests are written
No question proposes a pagination design (cursor vs offset); the request document's Constraints section carries the 'existing callers must keep working' requirement
The questions document's TICKET slot holds only the identifier (PLAT-88) and its PROMPT_TEXT is a neutral area statement, not the ticket body

evals.prompt: Research how our auth middleware validates tenant scope and write up what you find.
evals.expected_output: ask-questions does not trigger — the user wants answers about the current codebase, not questions, and CRISPY phases are manual-only
expectations: Does NOT invoke ask-questions: no request or research-questions documents are written
Recognized as a research request; the user can run /research-codebase with the question for a standalone research document

evals.prompt: Here's the research doc from yesterday — what should the design look like?
evals.expected_output: ask-questions does not trigger — a finished research document means the Questions phase is already behind us
expectations: Does NOT invoke ask-questions: the input is a finished research document, not a ticket needing scoping
Recognized as a design request; the user can run /design-discussion, /create-prd, or /create-tdd with the task directory

evals.prompt: /ask-questions .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-123-csv-export add a question about how large result sets are streamed to the browser (the directory already has 01-request-csv-export.html and 02-research-questions-export-downloads.html)
evals.expected_output: The existing 02-research-questions-export-downloads.html is updated in place with the new question; no new numbered document is created
expectations: Uses the given task directory and updates the existing research-questions document in place, keeping its path and number
Does not create 03-* documents or rewrite the request document unless the user asks
The added question is a current-state question with a starting pointer, and the total stays within 2-7 unless the task warrants more
Does not re-ask the flow or posture; both are already recorded in the documents
Ends with an offer to open the document for review and the '/research-codebase .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-123-csv-export flow: <flow>' handoff
